name: iam-adty/empira-app
description: An Empira application, and the reference for how one is put together.
//scripts: `./vendor/bin/empira`, not `php vendor/bin/empira` and not a bare `vendor/bin/empira` — the file carries a shebang and is executable, so the explicit path is both the shortest and the one that says what it runs. `serve` takes no `--host`, so it binds loopback: `APP_SECRET` signs every component URL, and a server reachable from the network is one where anything that can reach the port can mint a signed component URL and have the application fetch any component with any props. Pass `--host=0.0.0.0` deliberately, when the box is a VM you reach from elsewhere.
//repositories: Neither library is on Packagist yet, so both resolve from GitHub. `dev-main` tracks the branch rather than a release, so an application install follows whatever the libraries' `main` currently is — reproducible only while `composer.lock` is committed, which it is. The local path repositories that used to sit here made a sibling checkout resolve offline, at the cost of not working from a clone at all.
